name: Spiked light shield
source: Ultimate Equipment pg. 18, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 142
body:
Source Ultimate Equipment pg. 18, PRPG Core Rulebook pg. 142
Statistics
Cost 13 gp/19 gp Weight special
Damage 1d3 (small), 1d4 (medium); Critical x2; Range —; Type P; Special —
Category Light; Proficiency Martial
Description
You can bash with a spiked light shield instead of using it for defense. A spiked light shield can’t be disarmed. See the armor spikes entry on page 10 for details.
